negative_boundaries.statement: No second/stale catalog; no symlinks; no secrets in the channel; installer is idempotent and non-deleting.
The two existing sequences still pass their guard/tests; their automation scripts are untouched.
Live push-propagation to the home machine is out of scope; propagation occurs only on the home machine's next `git pull`.
Migrating the other approximately 20/27 skills is out of scope for this implementation.
The deferred natural-key/RowId business-key loader fix remains a separate track.
